name: Twinned
rule: Weight +1 on the gem's parameter.

name: Starred
rule: Base strike cap 5 instead of 3.

name: Phantom
rule: Stone also counts as one extra colour, chosen by its ID.

name: Rutilated
rule: On strike, +1 Intensity per distinct gem this beam has already struck this cast.

name: Silked
rule: Placing it costs no placement slot; one free Silked placement per cast.

name: Feathered
rule: At dawn it goes to next Night's opening hand.

name: Zoned
rule: Its Sympathy base is +6 instead of +2 (tiers add on top).

name: Clouded
rule: Weight -0.5 on its parameter; pays 1 Glint the first time it is struck each cast.

name: Veiled
rule: Ignores Short Night, Thin Air, Glass Tax and Tremor.

name: Flawless
rule: Counts one tier higher (max Radiant).

name: Fractured
rule: Weight +2 on its parameter; destroyed at dawn.

name: Asteriated
rule: On its first strike each cast, sends six small beams of its colour outward.

name: Chatoyant
rule: Rotates one step clockwise after every strike.

name: Included Twin
rule: Counts as two gems for Tight Setting, the Firefly Lantern and Glass Tax.

name: Ancient
rule: +1 Sympathy per Night it has survived this run.

name: Hollow
rule: Its cut does nothing, but it still counts as a strike and still gives Sympathy.

name: Pleochroic
rule: Stone cycles Ruby, Emerald, Sapphire by cast number.

name: Mirrored
rule: Mirror: both faces reflect. Other cuts: struck from any face.

name: Dense
rule: Immune to Tremor and Drift; adjacent gems gain +1 Sympathy.

name: Luminous
rule: At the start of a cast it shines a small beam of its colour where it points.
